summary: Right lung mid-to-lower zone haziness seen on the prior study is less evident on the current image, with clearer aeration.

findings.rationale: Prior right mid-to-lower lung shows diffuse patchy haze partially obscuring the vascular markings; current image at the same matched location (ribs and hilum as landmarks) shows the lung more aerated with distinct vessels. Rotation and projection are similar between exposures, so this is not a technical artifact.
